Services

What the workshop does

From the workshop’s sign, its Instagram and Facebook pages and its Google reviews.

Wheel alignment

The wheels are measured with measuring heads on every wheel and adjusted so the car runs straight. One customer writes about a Toyota Hilux with big wheels, all sorted.

Wheel balancing

Balancing of wheels and tyres, as the sign and the Instagram page say. One review mentions alignment and balancing, done fast and precisely.

Finding the cause

Six reviews say the car had been to other workshops before and the problem was only found here. One customer got a test drive after the work.

Appointments

For appointments, the Instagram page gives two phone numbers, the same as on the sign: 25 563653 and 99 416727.

In the workshop

Photos from the workshop’s Google listing.

How customers describe a visit

Taken from what customers write in their Google reviews.

Precise

Customers write about attention to detail, contemporary equipment and a car that drives straight at any speed.

Honest

One customer was told to change worn parts first and come back later, and was not charged for the visit.

Friendly

Reviews describe polite, kind and helpful staff who explain everything, and a drink while you wait.

A workshop for one job

AC Wheel Alignment Center works at Likourgou Logotheti 12 in Limassol, under a white sign with a red and blue line in the shape of a car. The workshop does wheel alignment and balancing, and one customer writes about a Toyota Hilux on big wheels, all sorted perfectly. One business with a fleet of vehicles calls it the most reliable alignment service in Limassol.
